npcs.name: Marshal Halwin
npcs.title: Town Marshal
npcs.greeting: Keep your blade close, $C. This valley is not what it was.

npcs.name: Trader Pell
npcs.title: Provisioner
npcs.greeting: Fresh bread, clean water, fair prices. What can I get you?

npcs.name: Apothecary Yarrow
npcs.title: Herbalist
npcs.greeting: Careful where you step in the eastern woods, friend.

npcs.name: Brother Edran
npcs.title: Town Priest
npcs.greeting: The Light keep you. Even the dead find no rest here of late.

npcs.name: Smith Dorn
npcs.title: Armorer & Weaponsmith
npcs.greeting: Mind the sparks, $C. Good steel is the difference between a scar and a grave.

npcs.name: Fisher Maelis
npcs.title: Old Salt
npcs.greeting: Grlmurlgrl— sorry, been listening to those fish-men too long.

npcs.name: Foreman Bram
npcs.title: Mine Foreman
npcs.greeting: Whole dig's crawling with those candle-headed vermin!
